description: Serving metrics for the vLLM - Qwen3.8-Flash-Next recipe. All vllm:* panels bind the model_name label to the dashboard's $model_name variable (label_values(model_name)), so a --served-model-name rename only needs the dropdown to refresh; scraped from qwen-3-8-flash-next:8000/metrics.

panels.description: Requests in the engine's running batch.
panels.title: Requests running

panels.description: Requests queued and not yet scheduled. Non-zero for more than a moment means the engine is saturated.
panels.title: Requests waiting

panels.description: Fraction of the KV cache in use. Sustained values near 1 with a non-empty waiting queue mean the engine is preempting or rejecting work.
panels.title: KV cache usage

panels.description: Accepted draft tokens / drafted tokens for the --speculative-config MTP draft path.
panels.title: MTP acceptance

panels.description: Tokens produced by the engine per second.
panels.title: Generation tokens / s

panels.description: up{job="vllm"} -- 1 means Prometheus is reaching qwen-3-8-flash-next/metrics.
panels.title: Scrape target

panels.description: End to end request latency measured in seconds.
panels.title: E2E Request Latency

panels.description: P50, P90, P95, and P99 TTFT latency in seconds.
panels.title: Time To First Token Latency

panels.description: Inter token latency in seconds.
panels.title: Inter Token Latency

panels.description: Number of tokens processed per second
panels.title: Token Throughput

panels.description: Number of requests in RUNNING, WAITING, and SWAPPED state
panels.title: Scheduler State

panels.description: Requests preempted and requeued per second -- KV pressure (gpu-memory-utilization, long contexts) shows up here first.
panels.title: Preemptions
Max Generation Token in Sequence Group

panels.description: NVML power draw of the RTX PRO 6000 (job gpu, gpu-exporter). Dashed line = enforced power limit. Energy counter lives at nvidia_smi_energy_joules_total if integrated watts are ever needed.
panels.title: GPU power draw

panels.description: Instantaneous GPU power draw vs the card's 300 W enforced limit (live query: power_limit=300, max=325). Orange at 240 W (80 %), red at 270 W (90 %).
panels.title: GPU power now

panels.description: kv_cache_usage_perc x 341041 = fp8 tokens occupied in the KV pool. The constant is the boot-time kv_cache_size_tokens (see the pool table); EDIT IT whenever gpu-memory-utilization / batch-pair / MTP config changes the pool, or the panel drifts from truth.
panels.title: KV cache tokens in use

panels.description: Percentage of used cache blocks by vLLM.
panels.title: Cache Utilization

panels.description: Cached prompt blocks / queried prompt blocks.
panels.title: Prefix cache hit ratio

panels.description: The KV pool as the engine reported it at boot (vllm:cache_config_info labels). kv_cache_size_tokens is the denominator behind both the usage % panels and the tokens-in-use panel; num_gpu_blocks x effective_attention_block_size is the same pool in blocks.

targets.expr: max by (cache_dtype, effective_attention_block_size, kv_cache_size_tokens, kv_cache_max_concurrency, num_gpu_blocks, gpu_memory_utilization, model) (vllm:cache_config_info{job="vllm"})

panels.title: KV cache pool (boot-time config)

panels.description: Fraction of drafts whose token was accepted at each speculative position (position is 0-based). A steep drop-off means the extra MTP depth is not paying for itself.
panels.title: MTP acceptance by draft position

panels.description: Accepted draft tokens per draft step -- the effective lookahead gained from speculative decoding.
panels.title: Accepted tokens per draft

panels.description: Heatmap of request prompt length
panels.title: Request Prompt Length

panels.description: Heatmap of request generation length
panels.title: Request Generation Length

panels.description: Number of finished requests by their finish reason: either an EOS token was generated or the max sequence length was reached.
panels.title: Finish Reason

panels.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint traffic from the FastAPI instrumentator (http_requests_total). Non-2xx includes 400 bad requests and 429/5xx.
panels.title: HTTP requests and errors

panels.description: up{job="prometheus"} -- scrape health of Prometheus itself.
panels.title: Prometheus

title: vLLM - Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
